publisher: Illinois Secretary of State, Business Services
ownership: Official Illinois corporation and limited-liability-company bulk records published through the Illinois Secretary of State Data Transparency page
source_access: Offline operator-supplied official files only. The connector performs no automated queries or downloads because the source page expressly prohibits automated queries.
allowed_use: manual placement of official daily files inside datahub
aggregate ZIP coverage analysis with explicit records-office and non-site semantics
prohibited_use: automated queries, scraping, crawling, or unattended download from the Illinois Secretary of State website without written authorization
public or customer redistribution before written source confirmation and a completed reuse review
retaining or exporting corporation president or secretary names and addresses, registered agents, LLC managers or members, or stock and finance fields
representing Goodstanding or Reinstated status as independent proof of current operations, licensure, solvency, public access, or an open storefront
representing an LLC records-office address as a verified physical operating site or establishment
claiming independent modified-modulus-11 check-digit validation when the source algorithm has not been published
guessing the ambiguous month condition in the corporation not-goodstanding annual-report rule
attribution: Source: Illinois Secretary of State, Business Services, Corporation and LLC Data Transparency files.
retention: Retain privacy-minimized, checksummed, immutable local-review releases until a reviewed retention operation removes them; do not retain excluded source fields.
redistribution: No redistribution is authorized by this profile. All outputs remain local-review-only pending written Illinois SOS confirmation and a separate reuse/redistribution review.
personal_data_handling: The connector reads fixed-width rows only to select approved fields and never persists corporation officer regions. It does not ingest agent, manager/member, assumed-name, stock, or other person-linked datasets. Organization names can incidentally contain a person's name because they are registered legal names.
